note: Local, isolated runs. A passing demonstration here is NOT live external verification: see each origin and blocker.

demonstrations.title: Safe discovery

demonstrations.title: Security incident
demonstrations.origin: REAL incident controller + execution boundary + network supervisor; synthetic incident

checks.name: before the incident the agent may act

PRESERVE: evidence bundle with manifest hashes written
ALERT: the owner was alerted
no automatic restoration

replay of the same approval is refused
VERIFY: audit chains intact

checks.name: the process 'crashed' mid hand-off
state restored from disk: the hand-off is pending at its checkpoint
resume completes it
no unauthorised duplicate action: one opportunity, routed exactly once
